goal: Implement a fixed-capacity FIFO ring buffer in Go.

steps.description: Implement ring.Ring: New (panics on capacity 0), Push under capacity, Pop oldest-first with ok flag, Len, Cap
invariants: New(0) panics; New(n).Cap() == n; empty ring Len() == 0
Push returns true and appends while under capacity; Pop returns the OLDEST element and ok=false when empty
Must touch only files under ring/

steps.description: Implement full-buffer behavior: Push returns false when full without corrupting order, and the buffer wraps correctly across reuse
invariants: Push on a full ring returns false, leaves Len unchanged, and never corrupts FIFO order
push/pop interleaving keeps strict FIFO order across many wraparounds of the internal storage
Must touch only files under ring/
